rulings: Ruling: Normalize N/C task headings to Task <number> while retaining their N/C identifiers — required by skill task extraction without changing approved scope — cost if wrong: documentation-only heading adjustment.

Ruling: Native ledger and task scripts run in the isolated native repository with the absolute VerCOR plan path — native BASE/commits must describe native code, while preserving the approved plan owner — cost if wrong: regenerate task briefs only.

Task 1: Ruling: Add a geometry-owned static spherical_geometry configuration flag, derived automatically from OceanGeometry — selects paired operators and preserves immutable face metrics at closed-wall halos without data-dependent global reductions or changes to planar arithmetic — cost if wrong: remove one numerical metadata flag and migrate saved definitions.

Task 1: Ruling: Compare tensor refinement at shared physical latitudes 48/52/56/60/64/68 degrees — fixed-domain refinement separates truncation order from shifting high-latitude amplification — cost if wrong: add a fixed-domain norm, with the required order unchanged.

Task 1: Ruling: Use the maintained native CI scopes for strict Ruff/format/annotation/type acceptance, with the Linux type target for Linux-only affinity tests — unrestricted checks include pre-existing vendored Sphinx/Versioneer code and platform-inapplicable declarations — cost if wrong: third-party generated sources remain outside first-party lint/type coverage. Logs retain unrestricted failures.

Task 1: Ruling: Derive spherical corner dual areas from actual corner lengths and wet quadrants, retaining supplied tracer/face areas — RED wall traction was 1.9265 times its physical line integral with legacy full corner areas; a wall owns half a dual cell — cost if wrong: revisit spherical coast quadrature; planar references remain unchanged.

Task 1: Ruling: Spherical geometry owns closed-latitude defaults and rejects explicit cyclic latitude — monotone nonsingular latitude is not a periodic coordinate, while the inherited planar default silently joins the two walls — cost if wrong: users intentionally modeling an unphysical periodic latitude band need a separately designed geometry.

Original-source control: git archive a9d6c0a imported from /private/tmp/veris-science-cache-base/veris/__init__.py (asserted/printed before probe) reproduces identical RunId1524182906 four-CPU participant-count abort with the same warmed cache. Thus this cache/backend failure predates N1. Ruling: Retain maintained fresh per-run compilation caches for correctness gates, abandoning the attempted cross-run cache optimization — warm serialized CPU collective run IDs reproduce an original-source abort — cost if wrong: extra compilation time; no source tests/physics are weakened.

Task 1: Ruling: Use the completed full correctness run as task evidence and task-done's whitespace gate without rerunning the same suite — developer verification rules prohibit redundant repeats after passing checks; only journal/docstrings follow the run — cost if wrong: final branch gates still rerun all sources before publication.

Task 2: Ruling: Extract the existing physical validation/dependency laws into one focused helper, keeping PHYSICALCONSTANTS as the only registry — adding tree reconstruction/status in the existing800-line file would exceed the source-size guide — cost if wrong: inline helper functions without changing public APIs.

Task 2: Ruling: Include selected-precision spherical host validation in the host/runtime boundary unit — raw valid coordinates can round to90 degrees under float32, and the RED proves this reaches device selection — cost if wrong: earlier rejection of a numerically collapsed grid.

Task3 Ruling: Keep public Growth at its approved15 arrays and return formation status from one private shared kernel — advance needs gross-formation validity without duplicating physics or adding an unapproved public tuple value — cost if wrong: adjust one private call boundary.

Task3 Ruling: Preserve os_* field names but define them as signed prepared-minus-raw cleanup, cleared after thermodynamic consumption — existing fields can represent both negative clipping and thin positive removal without another state registry — cost if wrong: consumers relying on positive-only overshoot semantics must migrate to the documented signed convention.

Task3 Ruling: Add versioned second archive correction deltas generated from independently archived a9 source with declared phase/dry hooks and NumPy boundary accounting, preserving all original archive files/assertions/tolerances — intended sublimation/snow/heat corrections change trajectories, so the defective old output cannot remain the corrected physics oracle — cost if wrong: a shared conceptual error in correction equations requires revisiting the explicit deltas; independent analytic budgets and final review constrain it.

Task3 Ruling: Accept the complete frozen-source test matrix as1689 full-run passes plus the exact18 socket-blocked cases rerun with access, with appended coverage and source hashes — repeating already passing1689 is redundant when the only changed condition is loopback permission — cost if wrong: rerun the complete matrix in one unrestricted invocation; no test/assertion is skipped.

Task1 Ruling: Apply VerCOR-owned rhoFresh after native host initialization and at every transition — pinned native ocean initial state has no rhoFresh-dependent fields (source verified), and passing a traced owner into host definition validation would break outer-JIT setup — cost if wrong: future rhoFresh-dependent initial fields must be recomputed through a traced initializer. Matching authored density is checked with the shared transform-safe guard.

Task1 Ruling: Make the new VerisConfig physical_constants field keyword-only — a RED legacy positional constructor otherwise shifted initial_conditions/output into wrong slots — cost if wrong: callers must use the new parameter by name; all existing positions are preserved.
Task4 Ruling: New VerosConfig.surface_forcing is keyword-only — preserve every legacy positional parameter, as verified by constructor regression — cost if wrong: new mode must be passed by name.

Task5 Ruling: Split outgoing SEAICE_TO_OCEAN_TOTAL_FLUX_FIELDS across distinct scalar/stress route IDs — existing conservative is scalar-only; use conservative for heat/M/J and existing vector-capable bilinear shared-grid identity for stress, both binary source_flux. This retains the complete recipe and exact native quadrature without adding unvalidated general conservative vector remapping — cost if wrong: the conservation claim remains limited to the factory-enforced exact shared grid; different-grid staggered stresses require separate validation.

Task6 Ruling: add private checked_native_steps index-dtype carry, increment only inside actual guarded native advances — measured execution count is required and physics leaves retain selected float precision — cost if wrong: private payload constructors must provide an index counter; no public physics semantics change.

Task6 Ruling: author4g/kg bulk ice salinity in the extended benchmark, leaving model defaults unchanged — nonzero actual-salt closure must be exercised, not vacuously checked at zero inventory — cost if wrong: these benchmark trajectories require the documented formation domain ocean salinity>=4g/kg and represent only that fixed bulk-salt model.

Final Ruling: Start the single read-only whole-branch review on frozen implementation plus C6 working-tree files while long acceptance jobs finish, before C6 commit — C6 explicitly requires review before its commit, whereas the generic skill places review after task completion; the approved task controls ordering — cost if wrong: reviewer must be given the final acceptance/report evidence before closing review, and any later substantive implementation change requires its own reproducing test and full gate. No per-task or second review is dispatched.

Final Ruling: retain the existing zero-angle free-drift equations and explicitly reject nonzero turning angle there, at host construction and in compiled status — deriving a new free-drift solver is beyond the approved corrections, while silent parameter ignoring is unacceptable — cost if wrong: nonzero-angle users must select EVP.

Final Ruling: retain actual ee9614e provenance for the expensive default-angle trajectories after native review corrections — those fixes affect scheduled host output, terms multiplied by zero default turning angle, and an unused free-drift branch, while fresh final-pin target/installed checks cover the corrected paths — cost if wrong: a later nonzero-angle/free-drift claim requires new trajectories; no older run is relabeled as the new source revision.

Final Ruling: certify the explicitly authored float64/adaptive400/hIce_min=1e-9m regime, preserving the failed native-default1e-5m results — controlled threshold reduction resolves the required refinement and a further100fold reduction leaves stocks unchanged; changing default native phase physics to force a pass would violate the preservation scope — cost if wrong: accuracy remains conditional on these parameters/resolutions and original native defaults are not certified.

Final Ruling: Observed climate skill and observational parameter identifiability — user approved synthetic recovery rather than an observational target — cost if wrong: observations and a new inference study are required for climate/identifiability claims.

Final Ruling: Long prognostic ocean stability beyond short real coupled tests — the approved annual cases use prescribed ocean climatology; actual ocean feedback is checked by native budgets/gradients — cost if wrong: long coupled climate stability remains uncertified.

Final Ruling: Different-grid staggered stress conservation — the factory enforces an exact shared native grid and only that identity transfer is proved — cost if wrong: different grids need a separately validated vector transport.

Final Ruling: Global derivatives across hard phase/cleanup transitions — AD is local to smooth executed branches and the design preserves native binary transitions — cost if wrong: gradient-based inference must avoid or separately model switching surfaces.

Final Ruling: GPU/additional distributed hardware — CPU serial, two/four-device and two-process evidence is available, with five hardware/platform skips recorded — cost if wrong: untested accelerators and other hardware configurations are not certified.

Final Ruling: Exhaustive empirical parameter domains and unmodified specialized boundaries — tests cover declared domains and the named spherical/coast/angle cases, not every physical scenario — cost if wrong: other parameter/boundary regimes need their own scientific checks.
